At Samen Oplopen, we connect volunteers with families in Gouda who could use a helping hand for a variety of reasons. As a volunteer, you walk alongside a family for an extended period and help them on their way. You are supported in this by a coordinator who remains involved in the background. Would you enjoy supporting this family? Would you like more information or to discuss whether this is something for you? Please contact us. We would love to get to know you!
